verdict.rationale: Secureframe ships generative AI features (Comply AI for Policies, Risk and vendor reviews), so a training opt-out or no-training data commitment is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The AI feature descriptions and MCP docs cover what the AI does, not how training data is handled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
